title: Absorb the approximant base 9 p^2 + p^6 exp(-p^2) (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Under the same gate `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `16 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`,

```text
g (9 p^2 + p^6 exp(-p^2))^{g-1} p^6 exp(K p - p^2) < 2^{-C p}
```

for integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`. For every integer `p ≥ 64`, `p^6 exp(-p^2) < 1/2`, so

```text
9 p^2 + p^6 exp(-p^2) < 9 p^2 + 1 < 16 p^2.
```

The comparison `9 p^2 + 1 < 16 p^2` is `1 < 7 p^2`. The base stays strictly below `16 p^2`, so the telescoping exponent is the same power of two already cleared for `(16 p^2)^{g-1}`, and it is at most `-C p - 4`.

The section ceiling `9 p^2` and the section error stay hypotheses. At `g = p^2` the approximant monomial is still greater than 1. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`.

This answers the open question of #4496. It does not replay #4496. The face factor 2 is left open. #4486 is the same shape with coefficient 10.
